Class TalonFXInputs

java.lang.Object
com.stuypulse.robot.util.talonfx.logged.TalonFXInputs
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable, org.littletonrobotics.junction.inputs.LoggableInputs
public class TalonFXInputs extends Object implements org.littletonrobotics.junction.inputs.LoggableInputs, Cloneable

TalonFX Inputs

Contains logged data collected from a LoggedTalonFX.

A TalonFXInputs instance is typically stored as a field in a subsystem's IOInputs class: 

@AutoLog
public static class IntakeIOInputs {
    public TalonFXInputsAutoLogged pivotSignals = new TalonFXInputsAutoLogged();
    public TalonFXInputsAutoLogged rollerSignals = new TalonFXInputsAutoLogged();
}

The values are populated by LoggedTalonFX.updateInputs(TalonFXInputs).
